_readme: Every entry must carry a non-empty 'reason' — the gate refuses to start otherwise. Optional 'rule' scopes an entry to one rule id. Exact-value matching only: no patterns, no guessing. This is the TEMPLATE allowlist that ships with the repo — replace the example with your own intentional findings, each with a real reason.

entries.reason: EXAMPLE ENTRY — replace or delete. Pattern: an address you deliberately publish as a public contact.
